TRACK_CHUNK: Track each chunk with the plan (`update_plan`).
MATCH_SPECIALIST: Specialist knowledge loads as Agent Skills, automatically from their description or explicitly with `/skill:<name>` (e.g. `/skill:python`, `/skill:go`, `/skill:ship`).
COLLAB_SECTION: - Use subagents (the `pi-subagents` package) to isolate context for research, review, debugging and running tests. Give each a self-contained instruction (paths, constraints, expected output). Tightly coupled work stays sequential.
EXTRA_SECTION: - MCP servers live in `~/.omp/agent/mcp.json` (omp only; plain `pi` has no MCP support). For one-off capabilities a documented CLI, a skill or `omp install <pkg>` is often simpler.
- For current information use the `brave-search` MCP server (omp only, when a Brave Search API key is configured). If it is missing, say so rather than guessing.
- The `pi-checks` extension runs tests, lint and type-checks after edits and at turn end. It does not block, so read its findings and fix real issues.
